d:
Groove to the magical beats of "Bujji Bangaram" video from the movie "Guna369"! Featuring Karthikeya and Anagha, this captivating track by Chaitan Bharadwaj is sure to get you hooked.
Song : Bujji Bujji Bangaram
Movie Name : Guna 369
Production House : SG Movie Makers
Producer : Thirumal Reddy Amireddy & Kadiyala Praveena
Director : Arjun Jandyala
Music Composed By : Chaitan Bharadwaj
Lyrics : Ananth Sriram
